§6Blast Furnace§f

§aThis is where the real metalworking begins. Alloys, steel, the works.§f

The §bBlast Furnace§f runs on solid fuel (coal, lignite, blaze rods, lava) with a big internal buffer. It burns 800 fuel per recipe and can hold up to 25,600. Add an §bextension§f on top for 3× speed at no extra fuel cost.

Craft it at a Tier 2 anvil from stone bricks, firebrick, and copper plates.

§6Key Alloys§f:
§b• Steel§f: iron + coal (ore + flux/coke gives 2-3 ingots)
§b• Red Copper§f: copper + redstone
§b• Advanced Alloy§f: steel + red copper
§b• Neutron Reflector§f: tungsten + coal

§ePS:§f Build multiples for serious throughput. One blast furnace will bottleneck everything.
